text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fg3m) AS three_pointers_made, SUM(fg3a) AS three_pointers_attempted, CASE WHEN SUM(fg3a) > 0 THEN SUM(fg3m) * 1.0 / SUM(fg3a) ELSE NULL END AS three_point_pct FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY three_pointers_made DESC, player_name ASC LIMIT 10
